changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwappointment AS SELECT a.id, a.facility_id, a.department_id, a.availability_generation_batch_id, a.resource_type, a.resource_id, a.capacity_index, a.start_datetime, a.end_datetime, a.patient_id, a.default_service_id, a.default_practitioner_id, a.reason, a.booking_mode, a.status, a.service, a.service_group_id, a.deferred, a.deferred_at, a.no_show_reason, a.cancel_reason, a.cancelled_by, a.priority, a.origin_type, a.origin_name, a.note, a.follow_up_encounter_id, a.checked_in_at, a.confirmed_at, a.created_by, a.created_date, a.last_modified_by, a.last_modified_date, a.booking_group_id, a.waiting_list_id, a.require_confirmation, a.require_practitioner, a.hl7_appointment_number FROM public.appointment a;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwappointment TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwappointment FROM report_user;
